result.summary: Replaces a stale commented-out TODO in functional test wallet_send.py with a functional test case. The new test verifies send RPC behavior when fee_rate is below mempoolminfee, checking both the add_to_wallet=false (transaction rejected by testmempoolaccept) and add_to_wallet=true (transaction stored in wallet but not accepted to mempool) paths.
result.problem: wallet_send.py contained commented-out test code from PR 16378 with deprecated parameters (estimate_mode="sat/b"), leaving behavior untested when an explicit fee_rate satisfies mintxfee and minrelaytxfee but falls below mempoolminfee.
evidence: PR description notes: "wallet_send.py had a commented-out TODO from the original send PR (#16378)... The commented code was stale; estimate_mode=\"sat/b\" no longer exists."

PR description observes that "an explicit fee_rate is only checked against max(-mintxfee, -minrelaytxfee), not against mempoolminfee (see src/wallet/fees.cpp), so when the mempool is full, send can build a tx the node won't accept."
result.changed_since_previous: Diff inspected; the patch implementation directly matches the earlier summary.
result.card: Replaces an obsolete commented-out TODO in functional test wallet_send.py with an active test exercising send when fee_rate is below mempoolminfee. It verifies that when add_to_wallet is false the transaction is returned and rejected by testmempoolaccept, and when add_to_wallet is true the transaction is saved in the wallet but omitted from the mempool. This exercises an untested wallet fee-check edge case.

risk.why: Touches only functional test code for wallet_send.py; cannot affect node runtime or consensus.
